development.cohort: new development only; never a second independent H3; 600 fresh graphs, 200/stratum, unique personnel sets, generator index in [60000000,65000000), past exposed graph sets screened, exclude formal domain by range
development.primary: original and paraphrase on each graph plus q0/q1/q2/q3 on each reversible graph, average all available primary views and 3 seeds within each graph; mean graphs per stratum then equal 3 strata
development.auxiliary: original alone, and 600 previously unseen-template views outside primary. Reversal both correct, quartet, paraphrase decision agreement, coverage, per seed, gate groups
development.bootstrap: PCG64(2026112417); joint paired stratified graph resampling 10000, one-sided lower sorted order 500 one based
development.h1: Sum shared token probabilities over every mention of each of the two question relation types; select max, award 0.5 on exact equality. Lexical baseline = first mentioned relation, not the first candidate. Pass overall accuracy >=0.80 AND lower95(candidate minus lexical) >0.
development.h2: Paper H2 with original frozen gate and candidate order: primary Top1 minus uniform weighting of all nonpadding question tokens, gain >=0.02 AND lower95>0. Gold outside top2 counts as a miss; equal candidate score chooses first. Additional relation-mask uniform for R12 is diagnostic.
development.h3: Historical once-only R09, R12 checkpoint and historical baselines only. No drawing new H3 or altering freeze retrospectively. New H1/H2 criteria are prospective on the new development cohorts and postdate formal R09.

stop: Stop if remaining 20-round/8-hour budget reached, assumptions structurally refuted and documented, or a fixed eligible version passes both H1/H2 and its historical H3 can be identified. If new H3 is required for a new version or ordering, record absence and exhausted opening. Never rescore independent raw samples for development.
